## About

The ComponentOne CalcEngine library is a fast and extensible expression parser which can parse and evaluate expressions like MS Excel.

Key Features:

* Provides an extensive built-in function library which supports formulas.
* Can parse and compute algebraic expressions, mathematical functions, and formulas using variables and across multiple spreadsheets or controls.
* Can be bound to business objects, collection views, dynamic types, Entity Framework and DataTables.

Learn more at [developer.mescius.com/componentone/docs/services/online-calcengine/overview.html](https://developer.mescius.com/componentone/docs/services/online-calcengine/overview.html).
